sd_fisher.text: Ramsey Island is across the sound. The Welsh name is Ynys Dewi, St David's Island. It is much too small to be as dramatic as it is.
In autumn the seals have pups on the beaches there. White, fluffy and furious. Give them room.
Pufflings waddle on the cliff top. Never stand between a Puffling and its burrow. It will take it personally.

sd_daughter.text: Dad says when the sea and the choir are in tune you have got hwyl. That is spirit and swing, all at once. I am working on it.
